notes.title: THE EVIL UPDATE IS LIIIIIIIVE!!!!!
notes.notes:
[p]have you ever asked yourself: "DAMN i wish i could walljump and dash and fly around in a horror game"? neither have i but i made it so now you can play it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192914/710278f379259fa18a210b74865743e5fd021e00.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192914/f453864eb903ebc76d4aa5a3e413344af113d757.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192914/fc9214ea23828d6033c3637169b76dbefe897b3b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192914/fbee7effd6abc31c2933c3f637be7cece02a7cfe.png"][/img][/p][p]its all about movement, speed = damage. surround sound is heavily reccommended to hear where things are coming from, so get some headphones.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192914/1f8cda2af15c7eabc98e10958205d5a8c147126f.png"][/img][/p][p]also, a totally different gameplay style as a challenge.[/p][p][/p][p]thats all for the horror boss, youll have to find out the rest yourself.[/p][p]the update features some new graphics stuff and customization stuff.[/p][p][/p][h2]Welcome to Brit's Fits[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192914/df3fb83998e3b408948f674143c27cff36e5b454.png"][/img][/p][p]get your drip or just get drippy with the new store around the lobby, which feels more lively than ever with the new day cycle[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192914/ad969aa7d46a9909fbdbc0f2c7de567dbe844dc4.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192914/6c9322c92893c23d208a29812eb2f355a9b66925.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192914/f1ba11e868fd9a92ccc93505c420897d1a8e2ecd.png"][/img][/p][p]To everyone who likes to run windows on ceiling fans, theres new graphics settings. its just a slider but it works.[/p][h2]High:[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192914/b90df0b1028c7e794cdcc77e22f92e290debf315.png"][/img][/p][h2]Low:[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192914/6b7621c7de07e869810e16182a6dc5526e610afb.png"][/img][/p][p]go get those new achievements too, and hey if youve read this far maybe youd check out the [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IdBHbX7bxNc"]soundtrack[/url] or join the [url="https://discord.com/invite/7ESSbwmTDy"]discord server[/url] to get some sneak peaks and chat around. im not evil, promise.[/p]

notes.title: Release day!
notes.notes: [p]Welcome to Slapstick Bosses, the game where random sh*t happens all the time. Fight sentient elevators, end a bloodline of cats, chase after wizards, or take down cybernetic supersoldiers in this wacky new experience. Theres some other stuff too, like cosmetics and challenge levels and such. Secrets are everywhere if you like those. You'll just have to find out yourself. Yes I plan on updating the game in the future, as of now you can check up on what I've got cooking somewhere around the lobby, just try to find it idk. Maybe review the game if you like it? F*ck it, review the game if you hate it.[/p]
